== Biography ==
William was born before 1660. He is the son of [[Glasgow-3078|Archibald Glasgow]] and [[Watson-45727|Agnes Watson]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-3078]] is assessed at 97% (proved). William’s 1660 South Leith index names Archbald Glasgow and Agnes Watson. Archibald-3078’s maintained adult Leith account contains the same Agnes household, also represented by the 1658 George entry. The full couple, parish and short family sequence strongly identify the father.

The 1660 child and Archibald/Agnes household97%; the earlier Hilstoun marriage and Archibald’s own origins retain their separate evidence. Original uninspected.

Next useful test: Check the 1662 testament and household entries for surviving children and the wife sequence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3080 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-3080]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.
